title: CM wants 3 PRTS corridors tendered by December

slides.head: CM wants 3 PRTS corridors tendered by December
What happened
slides.body: Corridors: LB Stadium to Ranigunj via Tank Bund; Assembly Metro to Begumpet via Secretariat; KPHB Metro to Biodiversity via Durgam Cheruvu and Mindspace, per TOI.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: The CM said the aim is to improve urban mobility and cut congestion, with speedy execution.

slides.head: PRTS corridors proposed
slides.body: Multi-level parking with PRTS depots is planned at Necklace Road and near IKEA, Gachibowli.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: The CM wants corridors finished within one year of work commencing.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Whether tenders are floated by December as the CM directed. Ask: How will PRTS fares compare with metro and bus fares?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

CM wants 3 PRTS corridors tendered by December

Revanth Reddy asked officials to prepare Personal Rapid Transit System corridors across central Hyderabad and the IT corridor to ease traffic.

Why it matters: The CM said the aim is to improve urban mobility and cut congestion, with speedy execution.
